name: @pipeworx/mcp-usgs-critical-deposits

tools.name: usgs_cmd_deposits_search
tools.description: Search USGS's "Critical mineral deposits of the United States" database (ver. 3.0, September 2026) — 1,271 documented deposits across 41 states + Puerto Rico. Filter by commodity (e.g. "lithium", "cobalt", "rare earth elements"), US state/territory abbreviation, and/or a bounding box. Returns each deposit's id, name, state, coordinates, minerals, deposit type, and resource figures. AUTHORITATIVE for "where are US lithium/cobalt/REE deposits" and "which critical mineral deposits are in <state>". Sourced from USGS.

commodity.description: Critical mineral/commodity, e.g. "lithium", "cobalt", "ree", "copper". Matched against the dataset's own commodity vocabulary (not a canonical element list) — an unmatched value returns found:false with the full commodity list.

state.description: US state or territory 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. "CA", "AK", "PR".

tools.name: usgs_cmd_deposit_detail
tools.description: Full record for one deposit from USGS's "Critical mineral deposits of the United States" database (ver. 3.0, September 2026) — minerals, deposit type, mineral system, production history, resource/reserve figures, references, and a link to the underlying MRDS/ARDF/USMIN record. Sourced from USGS.

id.description: Deposit id (the "id"/fid field from usgs_cmd_deposits_search results), e.g. "150".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-usgs-critical-deposits forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the usgs-critical-deposits pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
